title: Pasulka and the Vatican archives

tellings.quote: Maybe religious studies professor Diana Walsh Basila, who has visited the Vatican archives and speaks with conviction that the Catholic Church knows more than meets the eye about UFOs

plain: The Catholic Church may know more about UFOs than it lets on, Michels suggests, pointing to the religious studies professor Diana Walsh Pasulka. He says she has visited the Vatican archives and "speaks with conviction" that the Church "knows more than meets the eye." Michels mentions this himself in passing, during an episode with a former presidential adviser, and does not give her evidence.
